newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening lower after data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening lower after data.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to head lower at the start of trading on Wednesday as the bond market was further weakened by higher than forecast March industrial production and capacity utilization data.
Industrial production rose by 0.9 percent, compared with a revised 0.6 percent increase in February, while capacity utilization rose to 84.1 from the previous month's revised reading of 83.6 percent.
The market is also expected to come in for some profit-taking at the start following yesterday's 135-point rally in the Dow industrials.
